name: CoreTimesheet
intent: An agentic-first workforce time-verification command center: an operational briefing (present, attendance, verified hours, verification progress + an AI summary), a large 'Needs Attention' grid of severity-ranked operational queues (missing arrival/exit, no timecard, low confidence, long hours, suspicious attendance, contractor issues, shift exceptions), proactive AI recommendations that explain why they surfaced, a natural-language workspace that builds focused views, investigation case sheets (what happened, why, evidence, resolution, impact, suggested actions), and a demoted worker-records evidence table with grouping and bulk review.
when: A manager over tens of thousands of workers must know what needs attention first, not browse rows
Time/attendance verification where decisions and operational situations matter more than raw records
An operations 'command center' that groups work into queues and opens investigations before individual records
whenNot: A straight editable worker/timecard list -> use a DataTable list page
A KPI + charts analytics readout with no queues or cases -> use the Analytics Overview template
A single record's fields -> use a Detail page

chooseOver.component: A raw worker DataTable with filters
chooseOver.because: The command center turns 25,000 rows into a briefing, ranked queues, and investigations, keeping the table as a secondary evidence layer.

lineage.authoredBy: Agentic-first redesign of the Timesheet workforce time-verification screen (2026-07-12)

extracted: headline KPIs reframed as an operational briefing
25,604-row table reorganized into severity-ranked operational queues
per-issue investigation cases with evidence and suggested actions
